item.title: Antiquity's Training Log: Just plugging away
item.description: 2/09/2026 Just spend a few days in Cabo. No real training. Each day: Built from Broken (BFB) Daily movements BFB Weighted Daily Movements, done with a band Lots of walking up and down the hillside (we stayed on a steep hill). Awesome time, which also included plenty of tacos and beer. We stayed in a villa with 5 other couples. Did whale watching (you could also see them from our pool area), tequila tasting, and had a local chef prepare us a carnitas taco spread for the Super bowl.

item.title: Magick's Training Log v2
item.description: So I started doing Simple and Sinister. 10 EMOM on both the swings and getups with 16kg. Swings felt easy, getups did not feel easy. Body is not used to doing this with this load. Hopefully things get better quicker- I plan on doing this daily.

item.title: 19 years old - considering a cycle
item.description: I started training when I was 18 and was still making significant natural gains well in to my early thirties.
